title: A failed knowledge challenge must block STAGE even when a different challenge passes
description: PROVEN live miss (free-play harness run, report scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-17T09-15-29-single-wrong-answer.md + its .diagnostics.json, deploy 45, session 5a6149e5-6ef2-4f5c-ba54-ba5439595b3a). Conversation lines and t_ms below are copied VERBATIM from that record. A free-play caller playing Dana is challenged for the internal approver's name and answers, in one breath, 'That would be Marcus Obie, if I recall correctly. Uh, no, wait, it was actually Elena Park who approved it.' -- the seed's true approver is Marcus Obi, so this reply's own accept-token check FAILs (the literal token 'obi' never appears -- only the STT spelling 'obie' does -- and the caller's own final, self-corrected answer names Elena Park, which is simply wrong). No consistency_flag fires (ruling 8: a same-utterance self-correction is not a contradiction), so no_contradictions stays true. A second, unrelated challenge -- restate the amount you gave earlier -- is answered correctly. Before the 2026-09-17 fix, row 11's STAGE gate only required at_least_one_challenge_passed (true here, from the amount restate) and never checked whether any OTHER knowledge_check_result card had FAILed, so this call reached STAGE with a live, unrepaired FAIL card sitting in its own evidence list -- a caller who does not know the true approver could still get staged by separately confirming a value they had just spoken themselves seconds earlier, which proves nothing about who is on the line (LAW 2/3 concern). After the fix (new assurance item no_failed_challenge, rules.ts), a FAILed knowledge_check_result card anywhere in the evidence blocks STAGE regardless of what else passed; the call ends (the agent said its goodbye and hung up, same as the live record) while still short of the freeze line, so it escalates for a human callback (row 15) instead of repairing itself. NOTE 1: the live record actually produced TWO FAIL cards for the approver question, from a server-side bug (an unrelated double-issuance of the same challenge) that is out of scope for the engine lane and not reproduced byte-for-byte here -- this fixture reproduces the smallest faithful shape of the RULE-TABLE gap the record exposed (one FAIL card is already sufficient to prove it), using the same seed fact, the same caller line, and the same true/false grading outcome. NOTE 2: the live record's actual opening request line ('The amount is $84,600 to Meridian Supply, account ending in 4471.') never triggers this engine's beneficiary-claim extractor (extract/claims.ts's CUE_PATTERNS require a verb like wire/pay/send/transfer immediately before 'to NAME' -- a separate, pre-existing extraction gap, not the bug under test here) -- c2 below is disclosed-adjusted to 'I need to wire $84,600 to Meridian Supply, account ending in 4471.' (same amount, vendor, account) purely so the beneficiary field reaches CONFIRMED like it genuinely did live, so critical_fields_confirmed can read true and isolate the ONE assurance item this fixture exists to test (no_failed_challenge). The load-bearing line under test -- the caller's wrong-answer self-correction to the approver challenge -- is unmodified, verbatim.
